hints: For Petral, there are n = 19 employees ordered in the stem-and-leaf diagram.
Count to the 10th value in the Petral leaves to find the median: 320 in hundreds = 32,000 dollars.
The lower quartile Q1 is the 5th value (31,200 dollars) and upper quartile Q3 is the 15th value (33,500 dollars).
walkthrough:
Step 1: Read Petral salaries from the back-to-back stem-and-leaf diagram:
There are $n = 19$ salaries. Notice the key indicates values in hundreds/thousands (e.g. stem $32$ leaf $0$ represents $32\,000$).
The $19$ ordered salaries for Petral are:
$30\,000, 30\,400, 30\,500, 31\,100, 31\,200, 31\,300, 31\,400, 31\,600, 31\,800, 32\,000, 32\,100, 32\,400, 32\,500, 33\,200, 33\,500, 33\,600, 33\,800, 34\,100, 36\,800$.

Step 2: Determine the median:
$$\text{Median position} = \frac{n + 1}{2} = \frac{19 + 1}{2} = 10\text{th value}$$
The 10th value in the ordered list is:
$$\text{Median} = 32\,000\text{ dollars}$$

Step 3: Determine the lower and upper quartiles:
- Lower quartile $Q_1$: $5$th value in the list:
$$Q_1 = 31\,200\text{ dollars}$$
- Upper quartile $Q_3$: $15$th value in the list:
$$Q_3 = 33\,500\text{ dollars}$$

Step 4: Calculate the interquartile range:
$$\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 33\,500 - 31\,200 = 2300\text{ dollars}$$

hints: Inspect the distribution of salaries at Petral: notice the single extreme high salary at 36,800 dollars.
Recall that extreme outliers distort the mean, whereas the median is resistant to outliers.
State that the median is better and give the reason: because 36,800 is an extreme value (or because the data is positively skewed).
walkthrough:
Step 1: Understand the impact of extreme values on measures of central tendency:
- The mean takes into account all values, so it is pulled toward extreme values (outliers).
- The median depends only on the rank order of values, making it robust against extreme outliers.

Step 2: Examine the Petral dataset:
Almost all salaries at Petral lie between $30\,000$ and $34\,100$, with a single isolated high salary at $36\,800$.
This single high salary is an anomaly or extreme value that would artificially elevate the mean.

Step 3: Conclude and state the justification:
The median is the better representation because $36\,800$ is an extreme value (outlier) or because the distribution has a positive skew.
